text:
harper: Quick heads-up — low-key get-together Friday 4:00pm in the kitchen. Two celebrations: Nina promoted to Senior PM 🎉 and Jamal just had a baby (Ezra) 👶🏼. Plan: card, small group gift, and cupcakes. Who can make it / bring something?
nate: Love! I can bring a thermos of coffee and some disposable cups ☕️
dina: Congrats Nina & Jamal!! Registry/link for gifts?
harper: Registry link: https://example.com/registry/jamal — totally optional. Thinking group gift (white noise machine + bedtime books) or a baby clothes bundle.
anjali: I can chip in. Is there a Venmo or should we route through expense?
people-ops-bot: people-ops: Please use the pooled gift form https://forms.example.com/gift or expense to code PPL-CELEB. Card will be printed and placed on the table.
bryce: Cupcakes sound better than cake to me (easier for people to grab). I can order if we want. Chocolate + lemon?
luke: Cupcakes 👍 I can sign the card and take a quick group photo. Jamal ok with pics?
jamal: Thank you everyone ❤️ — appreciate it. We're keeping baby pics private, internal only please.
remote-hq-bot: Remote folks: we added an e-card for signatures and messages: https://ecard.example.com/abc — everyone can add a note.
dina: RSVP: me, nate, harper, luke, anjali, bryce. Also happy to bring a small potted plant as a gift.
harper: Perfect. Plan: assorted cupcakes + GF option, pooled gift via form, printed card + e-card for remote folks. People-ops will manage funds through Thursday EOD.
bryce: I'll handle pickup. Catering note?
catering-coordinator: We can provide assorted cupcakes (chocolate, vanilla, lemon) plus one gluten-free chocolate option. Delivery Fri 3:50pm, cost $48 for 24 cupcakes.
harper: Confirmed: assorted + 1 GF. Delivery 3:50pm, meet at 4:00pm in kitchen.
nate: Also can someone make a tiny sign: "Congrats Nina — Senior PM" and "Welcome Ezra"? I can design and print tomorrow morning.
anjali: Ill post a short announcement in #general after the party with a promo blurb about Nina's new scope.
people-ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: card printed, pooled gift form open until Thu EOD, catering ordered for Fri 3:50pm.
harper: Thanks team — super appreciative. Big congrats again to Nina and welcome to Ezra! :party_parrot:
jamal: Really grateful, thank you all. We'll see you Friday (Noor says hi).
